Meteorology

Tekanan Rendah

An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is lower than that of the surrounding region, often associated with unsettled weather, precipitation, and potential turbulence.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Tekanan Rendah?

In this glossary, Tekanan Rendah refers to: An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is lower than that of the surrounding region, often associated with unsettled weather, precipitation, and potential turbulence.

How is Tekanan Rendah used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Beritahukan pilot tentang sistem tekanan rendah yang berkembang dengan potensi turbulensi di jalur pendekatan."

Why does Tekanan Rendah matter in aviation?

Tekanan Rendah matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Tekanan Rendah?

Tekanan Rendah is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Tekanan Rendah belong to?

In this glossary, Tekanan Rendah is grouped under Meteorology. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is lower than that of the surrounding region, often associated with unsettled weather, precipitation, and potential turbulence.

Operational example

Advise pilots of a developing low pressure system with potential turbulence along the approach path.

Localized term

Localized example
